title: The Greatest Truth Isn't Found In Words

scenes.narration: The greatest truth isn't found in people's words. It's found in their actions.
scenes.image_query: The greatest truth isn't found in people's words. It's found in their actions.

scenes.narration: Sometimes people don't tell you the truth.
scenes.image_query: Sometimes people don't tell you the truth.

scenes.narration: Maybe they're protecting you. Maybe they're protecting themselves.
scenes.image_query: Maybe they're protecting you. Maybe they're protecting themselves.

scenes.narration: Maybe they're hiding something you'll never know.
scenes.image_query: Maybe they're hiding something you'll never know.

scenes.narration: But no matter how carefully the truth is hidden, their actions always reveal what their words conceal.
